messages:
zoe: Cumulus Networks reached out: want a private offer that bundles our Dedicated credits + their edge appliance rebate. They also want a coordinated marketplace listing + customer press during their partner summit (late Sept). Need commit tiers, simple renewal incentives, SKU names, and a short announceable blurb. Who can own?
omar: I can sketch tiers. leaning 12-mo commit with quarterly true-ups; propose optional 24-mo lock for deeper discount.
pri: Sales wants a 60-day enrollment credit (months 1-2) to push Q3 deals. Also want a renewal incentive (small credit if they renew early).
dan: Ops: marketplace listing must show "partner-managed rebate" and link to private-offer redemption URL. We'll need partner PO + SOW to enable rebate pass-through.
legal-bot: Do not promise HW rebate in public copy. Add auto-renew opt-out and export control language. I'll provide clause snippets.
omar: Draft tiers (USD, 12-mo):
````
- Intro: $6k/mo -> 6% discount, no rebate
- Growth: $42k/mo -> 14% discount + $10k HW rebate pass-through + 60d enrollment credit
- Enterprise: $160k/mo -> 23% discount + $45k HW rebate pass-through + 2w fast-start credit
Optional 24-mo lock -> additional 3% off. Quarterly true-up.
````
pri: Sales ok. Keep fast-start as add-on for Growth, include in Enterprise. Dan, can you post SKU names?
dan: Suggested SKUs: rwd-cumulus-intro-v1, rwd-cumulus-growth-v1, rwd-cumulus-enterprise-v1, rwd-cumulus-faststart-2w. Marketplace copy: neutral language, link to partner PO.
zoe: Assignments: Omar -> finalize pricing + private-offer JSON; Pri -> field one-pager + enrollment calc; Dan -> SKU registration + listing draft; Legal -> redlines. Target publish date: 2026-09-21 (partner summit) -> need final materials by 2026-09-07.
pri: I'll draft one-pager today and coordinate with solutions for demo kit.
legal-bot: I'll drop redline clauses by tomorrow.
zoe: Thanks team. Ping me @zoe with blockers. :rocket:
